backends.activeSlotDesc: Pick a vendor/key, then switch it as this backend's active slot. Failed switches are not marked success.
backends.codexProvidersDesc: Only vendors with GPT-related models (gpt-*/o1·o3·o4/codex). Switching sets the active Codex CLI provider.
backends.noProviders: No switchable providers. Add a vendor and key, then sync to backends.
backends.noGptProviders: No vendors with GPT-related models. Scan key models then refresh.
stats.desc: Filter by vendor, model, and engine — charts, drill-down, and export
stats.noData: No usage data for this period. Enable "Proxy via manager" on your vendors to track API usage automatically.
validation.nameAndKeyRequired: Name and API Key are required
sync.manualOnly: Import from backends is manual only (no auto-import timer).
sync.pushHint: Preview, then write to installed backends (uninstalled are skipped)
sync.pushStillRunning: Sync still running in background — refresh backends later
sync.pushPreviewDesc: Each row is a backend engine (not a key). Healthy keys are pushed into installed backends. Not installed / disabled / read-only backends are skipped.
sync.keysPoolHint: Syncable key pool (each backend may filter further)
dataRecovery.restored: data.json was corrupt; restored from backup {src} ({v} vendors).
dataRecovery.empty: data.json was corrupt and no backup was usable. Started with empty data.
sync.importHint: Manually import keys found in backend configs (preview first)
sync.importDesc: Manual only — no auto-import timer. Duplicates (same API key already in system) are skipped.
sync.noCandidates: No keys found in backend configs
backup.importHint: Restore or merge a backup file
backup.chooseMode: OK = REPLACE all vendors/settings. Cancel = MERGE (add missing only).
backup.confirmReplaceFinal: Replace will overwrite all vendors and settings. Continue?
backup.metapiDone: MetaAPI import: +{v} vendors, merge {m}, +{k} keys, move {mv}, skip {s}, no-key sites {nk}, checkin {c}
gatewayPanel.remoteWip: Remote gateway is under development and not available yet. Use Local mode.
stats.costEstimatedHint: Some costs are estimated from token unit prices when providers report 0
settings.pageDesc: Optional health schedule, local access token, and backups
settings.healthHint: Off by default. When enabled, keys are checked periodically in the background.
settings.accessHint: Optional token for this manager. Leave empty for open local access.
settings.clearTokenConfirm: Clear access token? Anyone with network access to this port can use the app.
settings.tokenIsSet: Access token is set (enter a new value to change)
diagnostics.desc: Environment, data path, CLI tools, and backend status for troubleshooting
diagnostics.downloadHint: Export a secret-free diagnostics JSON for GitHub issues
updates.upToDate: You are on the latest version (v{local})
auth.title: Authentication required
auth.desc: Enter the access token configured in Settings.
onboarding.title: Welcome to AI Switch
onboarding.step1: Add a vendor (or use Smart Import)
onboarding.step2: Add API keys and run a health check
onboarding.step3: Open Backends and push healthy keys
onboarding.step4: Optionally enable schedule / access token in Settings
onboarding.note: System data is source of truth. Importing from backends is always manual.
onboarding.panelDesc: Finish these four steps for a reliable setup. The dashboard highlights this guide until done.
onboarding.step1Desc: Add at least one vendor and one API key.
onboarding.step2Desc: Run a check until at least one key is healthy.
onboarding.step3Desc: Only installed tools receive sync. Open Backends to verify status.
onboarding.step4Desc: Push healthy keys, then send a test message in OpenCode / Codex.
onboarding.skipped: Guide hidden. Reopen it from Settings.
health.hintAuth: Check API key, endpoint URL, and whether the key is revoked.
health.hintQuota: Top up balance or wait for quota reset; disable if spent.
health.hintModel: Pick another check model or rescan models.
health.hintNetwork: Check internet, DNS, firewall, and proxy.
health.hintRate: Slow down or switch to another key.
health.hintSsl: Check proxy/MITM, system time, and HTTPS URL.
health.hintEndpoint: Open endpoint details — real cause may be auth, quota, timeout, or model.
audit.title: Audit log
batchImport.duplicateHint: This API key already exists in the system and will be skipped
settings.pricingHint: USD per 1M tokens. Overrides builtin estimates used when providers report cost=0. Format: {"model":{"input":1.0,"output":2.0}}
settings.budgetHint: Set 0 to disable. Alerts appear on dashboard at 80% (warn) and 100% (critical).
settings.budgetActionHint: Runs at 100%. Read-only / disable keys at most once per UTC day.
dedupe.hint: Find and remove duplicate API keys across vendors
dedupe.title: Clean duplicate keys
dedupe.desc: Same API secret kept once (prefer enabled keys with models). Preview below, then apply.
dedupe.confirm: Remove listed duplicate keys? This cannot be undone (unless you have a backup).
mergeVendors.hint: Merge vendors that share the same API URL (with/without /v1)
mergeVendors.title: Merge duplicate vendor URLs
mergeVendors.desc: Merge by normalized URL (trailing /v1 ignored). Keys move into the kept vendor; same secret kept once. Preview first.
mergeVendors.confirm: Merge vendors with the same API URL? Keys move into the kept vendor; merged vendors are deleted.
importUndo.hint: Restore snapshot taken before the last bulk import
importUndo.confirm: Restore data to before the last bulk import?
settings.healthAutoDisable: Auto-disable keys that fail health check
settings.healthAutoDisableHint: Off by default. When off, failed keys stay enabled in the system (only marked unhealthy).
emptyVendors.hint: Delete vendors that have no keys
health.recheckFailedHint: Only re-run health checks for keys currently marked failed
exportKeys.hint: Download all vendors/keys as CSV (includes secrets)
models.desc: All models discovered on your keys — click a location to open the vendor
models.empty: No models yet — run health check or model scan on keys
quality.title: Quality checks
quality.desc: Checks currently usable models using four deterministic prompts, accuracy, latency and response identity.
quality.costNote: Manual evaluation sends 4 short requests per model.
quality.noTargets: No usable non-official models in this scope
quality.navDesc: Inspect, filter and rerun deterministic quality benchmarks for usable models.
vendorModal.tagsHint: Comma-separated. Used for filtering in the vendor list.
settings.readOnlyHint: When on, all create/update/delete/sync APIs return 403. You can still turn this off in Settings.
settings.readOnlyBanner: Read-only mode — changes are blocked (disable in Settings)
settings.healthAutoFailover: Auto-failover primary → backup on failed health check
settings.healthAutoFailoverHint: Off by default. When a primary key fails health check, promote the first backup on that vendor, disable the failed primary, and re-sync backends.
settings.secretsHint: Optional. When on, API keys in data.json are encrypted with a password-derived key. Unlock in-process to use them. For headless: AI_SWITCH_SECRETS_PASSWORD.
settings.secretsStatusOff: On disk: plaintext (file mode 600). Encryption optional.
settings.secretsStatusLocked: On disk: encrypted · process: LOCKED — unlock to use keys
settings.secretsEnableConfirm: Encrypt all API keys on disk with this password? Remember it.
settings.secretsDisableConfirm: Write keys back as plaintext on disk?
settings.adaptiveHint: After consecutive fails/oks reach the threshold, that key uses a longer interval (scheduled runs only probe due keys; manual full check still probes all).
settings.networkRetriesHint: Retry only on network/SSL/timeout failures (default 3, max 10). Auth/quota errors are not retried.
keyModal.roleHint: Primary is preferred for backends; backup is standby for failover.
keyModal.checkModelHint: Primary check model: tried first. If it fails, other models from the inventory are tried at random; the key is unhealthy only if all fail. Model list is refreshed on every check. Leave empty to probe from inventory only.
confirm.promote: Make this key primary and demote other primaries on this vendor?
gatewayPanel.remoteNote: Test & save connection. Full remote push/import still uses local OpenClaw path when mode is local.
profiles.title: Config profiles
profiles.hint: Named snapshots under ~/.ai-switch/profiles/. Switch saves the current workspace first. Export encrypted profiles to share with teammates.
profiles.sharePasswordHint: When set, export is encrypted; use the same password to import encrypted files.
profiles.importActivate: OK = import and switch to this profile now. Cancel = save only.
profiles.switchConfirm: Switch to profile "{name}"? Current data will be saved to the previous profile first.
backup.passwordHint: Optional. When set, export is encrypted (PBKDF2). Import prompts if the file is encrypted.
backup.passwordRequired: This backup is encrypted — enter the password
policies.title: Policy templates
policies.hint: One-click presets for health checks, failover, budgets, and read-only. Save current form as a custom template.
policies.applyConfirm: Apply policy "{id}"? Health/budget settings will be overwritten.
checkin.pageDesc: Manage vendor check-in URLs. Vendors with a check-in URL are treated as check-in capable.
checkin.hint: Set check-in URL in vendor edit. Use the Actions column to check in, disable, or edit.
checkin.disableConfirm: Disable check-in and clear the URL?
vendorModal.checkinUrlHint: When set, the vendor appears under Check-in and is marked as supported.
health.pageDesc: Scheduled health monitoring — status, start/stop/pause, current keys, and run history
health.historyEmpty: No history yet — run a check or enable scheduling
routes.pageDesc: Downstream keys aggregate healthy vendors/models into one API key. Auto-update after health checks.
routes.name: Name
routes.endpointRequired: Select at least one endpoint type
routes.endpointHint: Clients call OpenAI: POST /v1/chat/completions · Anthropic: POST /v1/messages · List models: GET /v1/models (Authorization: Bearer <downstream-key>)
routes.autoUpdateHint: When on: drop unhealthy sources, add healthy ones that match selected models.
routes.selectedModelsHint: Leave empty = all models from healthy keys. Selection is the allow-list for auto-add.
routes.noModelsAvail: No healthy models yet — run health check first
tasks.title: Task center
archived.pageDesc: Archived vendors and keys appear only here; hidden elsewhere and excluded from health checks.
archived.confirmArchiveVendor: Archive vendor "{name}" and all its keys? It will be hidden from all views and health checks until restored.
archived.confirmArchiveKey: Archive key "{name}"? It will be hidden from all views and health checks until restored.
settings.archiveStreakDaysHint: Auto-archive a key after its health check keeps failing for this many consecutive days (0 = off, default 10). Archived keys only appear in the archive list and stop being checked.
